column1: # clues.tsv for ft_strncpy — hints only, never answers.
strncpy copies at most n bytes. If src is shorter than n, what fills the leftover bytes up to n? Look at the empty-src and n>len cases.
The classic strncpy trap: when n is less than or equal to the length of src, is the destination terminated at all? Check what sits right after the copied characters.
